### FINDING 1 — lem-cardinal-operations-are-well-defined — false page-wide choice claim
LOCATION: Remarks, lines 115–117  
QUOTE: "That is not a defect of this proof but the reason cardinal exponentiation is stated with the Axiom of Choice throughout this page."  
DEFECT: This is false. The same page explicitly develops choice-free instances of cardinal exponentiation.  
EVIDENCE: `lem-cardinal-arithmetic-basic-laws` states, "The four exponential unit laws need no choice principle." `thm-cardinal-arithmetic-agrees-with-finite-counting` states, "Work in ZF; no choice principle is used," and later says "the cardinal exponential being defined in ZF here because the function set it counts is finite."  
SEVERITY: fatal  
MINIMAL REPAIR: Replace the quoted sentence with: "General infinite exponentiation on this page is stated under the Axiom of Choice; the four unit cases and finite exponentiation are choice-free."
